name: Arcade
tagline: Arcade turns screen recordings into guided, clickable product walkthroughs. Marketing and sales teams use it to build demos that prospects can explore on their own, without scheduling a live call or setting up a sandbox. Demos embed in websites, emails, or share as a direct link.
